    scanf("%d",&x);
    return x;
}

bool visited[1000007];
const int MOD=1000000007;
long long count_div[1000007];
long long cycle_length[1000007];
long long dynamic[1000007];

int main()
{
    long long result=1;
    int p, k;
    p=read_int();
    k=read_int();
    for(int i=0; i<p; i++)
    {
        if(!visited[i])
        {
            int length=0;
            long long current=i;
            while(!visited[current])
            {
                visited[current]=1;
                current=((long long)k*current)%p;
                length++;
            }
            cycle_length[length]++;
        }
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=p; i++)
    {
        dynamic[i]=((long long)cycle_length[i]*i)%MOD;
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=p; i++)
    {
        count_div[i]=(count_div[i]+dynamic[i])%MOD;
        for(int j=i+i; j<=p; j+=i)
        {
            count_div[j]=(dynamic[i]+count_div[j])%MOD;
        }
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=p; i++)
    {
        if(i==1)
        {
            for(int j=0; j<cycle_length[i]-1; j++)
                result=(result*(long long)cycle_length[i])%MOD;
        }
        else
        {
            for(int j=0; j<cycle_length[i]; j++)
                result=(result*(long long)count_div[i])%MOD;
        }
    }
    if(k==1) result=(result*count_div[1])%MOD;
    printf("%lld", result);
    return 0;
